counterexamples.summary: Before repair, ordinary publication changed reviewed_by reviewer to publish, replaced review timestamp with publication time, and cleared original review notes.
Before repair, an injected failure after insert_entry left a committed entry for an approved candidate; SQLite dump differed after failure.

notes: Deterministic bounded example histories establish scoped Depth1 evidence; no generated reference-model, exhaustive protocol proof, concurrent-writer guarantee or central/PostgreSQL verification is claimed.
The three abrupt child exits test SQLite rollback during local publication; process exit occurs before commit and does not establish outcomes for a commit that completed without a response.
A committed publication remains a terminal transition. Repeated publish is refused; caller must inspect an unknown outcome. Historical inconsistent rows are neither deleted nor rewritten.

The test basetemp lies outside /tmp because an unrelated host /tmp/.git makes the existing outside-repository render test resolve project tmp. The first targeted run observed that unrelated failure; the isolated /var/tmp run passed.
No central schema, package pin, version, service, shared artifact or sprintctl state change.
